title: Races — Wildstrubel by UTMB 2027
publisher: UTMB World Series / Wildstrubel by UTMB
claims: The 2027 races page lists seven formats on 10–12 September 2027: Wild 110, Wild 70, Wild 55, Wild Glacier Marathon, Wild 25, Wild 10 and Wild NextGen.
The page intro says '6 distances from 10km to 110M', while it lists seven formats and the longest race is 113 km, not 110 miles.
The page gives Wild 110 4 Running Stones, Wild 70 3, Wild 55 2, Wild Glacier Marathon 2 and Wild 25 1, with no stones shown for Wild 10 or Wild NextGen.
The page gives Wild 70 72 km/+4,600 m, Wild 55 55 km/+3,300 m, Wild Glacier Marathon 42 km/+2,700 m, Wild 25 26 km/+1,200 m and Wild 10 10 km/+500 m.

verification.note: 2026-11-09 直接抓取并读取 2027 races 列表。
